title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：rubber　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rubber 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the researcher ① used the rubber that no student in the lab would have measured, and he said the using was the whole of the term. The ② rubber, meaning the material itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unmeasured in the book; rubber, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sample of rubber in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ rubber at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Rubber, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the researcher said the measuring is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rubber was the whole of the matter, meaning the flexibility and not the material. The ⑥ rubber, meaning the flexibility and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; rubber, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both material and a flexibility. He said the flexibility is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ rubber had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ rubber of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of measuring; rubber, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rubber I remember is the rubber measured in the paper, which closed in 1991 and is still measured as the quietest in the lab. ⑩ Rubber, my mother said in 1993, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all rubber, she said, is a flexibility that has agreed to look like material. She said the flexibility was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 橡胶；橡皮（指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 橡胶；橡皮（指那块橡胶本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the rubber 用这一块橡胶
D. n. 橡胶；橡皮（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 橡胶之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的橡胶之事）
F. n. 橡胶；橡皮（指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一块）
G. n. 橡胶、弹性（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 弹性（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the rubber that no student in the lab would have measured
The rubber, meaning the material itself and not the tube
Every sample of rubber in that lab
the rubber at the far bench
the rubber was the whole of the matter
the rubber had become a line in a paper
The rubber of the whole thing

answers.why: use the rubber 意为“用这一块橡胶”，1984 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯测量的一块橡胶做了一遍。
rubber 意为“橡胶；橡皮”，指那块橡胶本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被测量。
rubber 意为“橡胶；橡皮”，指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
rubber 意为“橡胶；橡皮”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rubber 意为“橡胶、弹性”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块弹性就是那件事的全部。
rubber 意为“弹性”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块橡胶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rubber 意为“橡胶；橡皮”，指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一块，到 1989 年这一块成了研究报告里的一行。
rubber 意为“橡胶之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的橡胶之事是一处实验室和三个学期的测量。
rubber 意为“橡胶；橡皮”，我记得的是研究报告里测量过的那一块，1991 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一块。
rubber 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，橡胶是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的橡胶。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年那位研究员用了实验室里没有一位学生肯测量的一块橡胶，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（use the rubber）
那块橡胶，指的是那块橡胶本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被测量。（rubber）
那处实验室里每一份橡胶旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（rubber）
最远那张实验台那块橡胶，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（rubber）
叔叔说这块弹性就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那块橡胶。（rubber）
1993 年母亲说，橡胶是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的橡胶。（rubber）

Every sample of rubber in that lab had the same short tube beside it.
The rubber at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the rubber was the whole of the matter, meaning the flexibility and not the material.
